name: Developer crew
description: Reads the story and the code, proposes an implementation plan with risks and test ideas, then shares it in Jira and creates the sub-tasks.

briefing.jql: project = {{project}} AND {{scope}} AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done AND issuetype not in subTaskIssueTypes() ORDER BY priority DESC
briefing.rankPrompt: You plan a software developer's day. Put first what is already in progress, then what is ready to start, by priority. Favour tickets that unblock other people. Mark as not actionable the tickets with no engineering work in them.
